_doc.purpose: Single declarative source of truth for which surface owns each bakeable world sample. Per CODEX 裁示 A: codegen targets are GLSL owner predicates, Python prepare/mask helper, JS validation/probe helper, and the scanner input table. Machine-readable fields are authoritative; note/citation/sourceLine are documentation only and MUST NOT drive any decision.
_doc.ownerApi: ownerOfSurface(sample) per CODEX 裁示 B. sample = { position{x,y,z}, normal{x,y,z}, objectId, hitType, candidateSurfaceId, sourceBoxIdx? }. A surface MATCHES a sample when normalGate AND objectIdGate AND (top-level x/y/z bounds OR any xRects entry combined with y/z bounds) all hold. The OWNER is the matching surface with the highest precedence. Equal precedence among >1 matches = conflict (scanner BLOCK). If the winning owner has pendingPolicy=='pending' the sample resolves to PENDING.
_doc.precedenceRule: Higher precedence wins at shared edges. Structural depth / reveal-depth tops (20+) outrank open ceiling/walls/floor (10), so a horizontal depth slab coplanar with the ceiling is owned by the depth surface, not the ceiling. CODEX 裁示 D: H1/H2 precedence MUST be > ceiling; ceiling converges to 'open ceiling'.
_doc.pendingPolicy: baked = surface has a real bake and is a valid owner. pending = a VISIBLE surface that is the correct owner but not yet baked; shown as PENDING debug colour, BLOCKs formal validation, must be self-baked. blocker = an INTERNAL_OCCLUDED boundary (e.g. solid-wall top behind the wall front) that is NOT visible from inside the room: it owns its region ONLY to stop a neighbour (ceiling) eating into the wall body and to give the scanner an ownership boundary; it is NEVER baked, NEVER shown as PENDING colour, and does NOT block formal validation. If a genuinely-visible small face is later found inside a blocker region it must get a NEW visible surfaceId, not reuse the blocker id (CODEX H1/H2 correction).
_doc.redlines: CODEX: no LIVE-diffuse fill; no single-ceiling-if patch; no c2c-mask-only hole patch. A-narrow stays a contact-edge cure plugged into this registry, NOT an owner-missing-surface fix.

fields.ownerClass: open_ceiling | wall | floor | structural_depth_top | reveal_depth_top | reveal_front | ... (documentation grouping)
fields.normalGate: { axis: x|y|z, sign: +1|-1, threshold } => owns only where normal[axis]*sign > threshold
fields.objectIdGate: { lt } => owns only where objectId < lt
fields.x|y|z: [min,max] world bounds (inclusive); omit an axis to leave it unbounded
fields.xRects: optional [[min,max],...]; when present the surface owns the union of these x-ranges (combined with y/z) instead of a single x range
fields.bakeTargetId: int|null; the bake/runtime target id when baked
fields.configId: int; which C-config (1-4) this surface's bake belongs to; loader rejects on runtime-config mismatch
fields.atlasGroup: shell | object; which active atlas this surface bakes into (shell=room envelope, object=furniture/gear)

surfaces.note: Open ceiling. Converged per 裁示 D: structural depth tops (south_wall_depth_top, south_window_top_reveal_depth) carry higher precedence and own the z[3.056,3.256] depth slab, so the ceiling no longer owns it. The pre-existing occluder-top footprint (z<=3.056 columns/beams) is a separate legacy concern not migrated in this first slice.
South wall FRONT plane (vertical, normal -Z) at z=3.056. It does NOT own the horizontal z[3.056,3.256] depth slab above it; that is south_wall_depth_top.

H1 = INTERNAL BLOCKER (CODEX H1/H2 correction). The horizontal top of the SOLID south wall, z[3.056,3.256], OUTSIDE the window x-band (x<=-1.75 and x>=0.69). The solid wall front (z=3.056) occludes this from every in-room viewpoint, so it is NOT a visible surface and carries NO bake responsibility. Its only jobs: (1) own this region so ceiling_open stops eating into the wall body; (2) give the scanner an ownership boundary. pendingPolicy=blocker => never baked, never PENDING colour, never blocks formal validation. If a genuinely-visible face is later found here, create a NEW visible surfaceId — do NOT reuse this blocker.

surfaces.bakeContractResolved: albedo-free single-multiply contract (CODEX 2026-06-16). History: the first real H2 bake 20260616-041925 was IDENTITY-correct but baked albedo-IN (dedicated pipeline multiplies hitColor) while the master runtime multiplies albedo AGAIN (multiplyAlbedoAfterBakeLookup=true) => double albedo => too dark/yellow vs the albedo-free ceiling. Fix written as a GLOBAL contract (not an H2 patch): (1) shader bake-time albedo-free skip generalised to any --r7310-separated-irradiance-bake dedicated bake (r7310SeparatedDedicatedBakeFirstHit, patchId-agnostic); (2) the separatedIrradianceBake flag, previously dropped between reportR7310C1DedicatedBeamColumnShadowBakeAfterSamples -> captureAtlas -> captureR738C1DirectSurfaceTexelPatch, now propagates so uR7310C1SeparatedBakeMode is actually set; (3) loader contract check: any master sub-rect with multiplyAlbedoAfterBakeLookup!=false must declare bakeAlbedoFree=true or the load fails. Re-baked albedo-free => 20260616-054126, luma 0.207->0.2794, junction z=3.056 0.334 ~= xatlas ceiling 0.303. Supersedes 20260616-041925 (double-albedo, VOID).

surfaces.note: Window top-reveal FRONT-edge band (vertical-ish, normal -Z) on the z=3.056 front plane. This entry is front-edge / legacy runtime CONTEXT only — it is NOT an independent dedicated bake face. Its in-room coverage comes from the existing top-reveal-shadow hybrid path (hybrid owner targetId 22), not from a dedicated master bake. bakeTargetId is null on purpose: 1022 was previously (incorrectly) shared here but 1022 is the -Y header bake-point patchId and now belongs solely to south_window_top_reveal_depth (CODEX step-6 ruling — no same-ID dual semantics). If a genuine -Z front-band master bake is ever needed, assign a NEW target id (e.g. 1024+); never reuse 1022.

Floor (C1A shell, R7-3.10 §13). floor_open = the master-ized version of the EXISTING floor (targetId 1001). PENDING until the non-square 800 texel/m albedo-free bake lands; then pendingPolicy->baked, bakeTargetId->1001. Identity pinned (CODEX): targetId/bakeTargetId stay 1001 — only atlasGroup(shell)/configId(1)/surfaceName(floor_open)/masterRect(floor)/bake-method(non-square albedo-free) change; no new floor targetId. Phase 1A wires this as PENDING so the master-mode magenta safety net fires over the floor footprint before any bake.

floorOcclusionExclusionsDoc.purpose: Occlusion Exclusion Map (bug#2). Negative footprints applied AFTER owner resolution: where owner==floor_open, these solid-geometry footprints over the floor are invalidated (metadata valid=0 -> atlas alpha=0 -> runtime falls back to LIVE). NOT owner surfaces, NOT precedence, NOT a c2c hole patch. Parallel to surfaces[] so it never touches the owner predicate / GLSL. Carries its own EXCLUSION_VERSION (codegen), independent of REGISTRY_VERSION which covers surfaces[] only — so adding/editing exclusions never changes the GLSL owner block.

fields.surfaceId: owner surface this exclusion applies to (floor_open)
fields.atlasGroup: aligns with the owner surface (floor_open=shell); the occluder object's own group is irrelevant
fields.configIds: [int]; which C-config layouts this footprint exists in
fields.furnitureMode: null for fixed geometry (walls); furniture slot mode (e.g. 'bed') for swappable furniture; only excludes when bake furnitureMode matches
fields.bounds: { x:[min,max], z:[min,max] } floor-plan AABB (inclusive world coords)
fields.margin: { mode, meters }; Step-B contact margin. meters MUST be 0 on the first re-bake; only set after audit proves residual contact hard-black.
fields.enabled: bool; false = schema-reserved but does not affect the bake
